name: optimism
quote: I think we're going to win.
description: A prediction that a particular desired outcome is possible, even if not certain.

variations.name: optimistic mindset
variations.description: A pattern of generally positive predictions, that most things wil work out just fine.

comparisons.description: 'Optimism' is more mental than 'hope' - not as emotionally invested.

Optimism is seeing the glass as half-full. Pessimism is seeing the glass as half-empty. Cynicism is suspecting that someone drank half the glass. Skepticism is not being sure it's really water in the glass.

commentaries.quote: Optimism is the faith that leads to achievement. Nothing can be done without hope and confidence.

conditions: A sense that a particular desired outcome is possible, even if not certain.
